main_measure.name: pooled mean 5-bar excess return (vs coin's window hold average) after top-quintile forecast bars
main_measure.threshold: confirm if pooled t >= 2 and the supporting check holds; reject if pooled t <= -2; otherwise inconclusive; at least 30 pooled non-overlapping top-quintile cases and at least 8 per coin

supporting_check.name: coins where top-quintile excess minus neutral excess > 0 (need >= 2)

decided_by: Pooled t = 0.50 lies between -2 and 2, the plan's inconclusive rule.
reading: The top quintile is the coin's non-zero forecasts at or above their 80th percentile over all its windows; the hold baseline is the mean 5-bar return over the window's non-overlapping grid; the per-coin minimum of 8 and the '2 of 3 coins' rule are applied to the coins present in the record (BTC, ETH), so both must be positive.
